name: oche-scorer
description: Darts scorer and trainer for the web and iOS

scripts.serve: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.icons: swift scripts/make-icons.swift icon 1024 web/icons/icon-1024.png && swift scripts/make-icons.swift mask 512 web/icons/maskable-512.png && swift scripts/make-icons.swift splash 2732 store/splash-2732.png
